Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-english-main-0-transcribe-medium-0172-reverse-00", "row_sha256": "0284ac800a632c0952e332e0000c06352e75c5669475aaab965663f4f92968cf", "mode": "/transcribe", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Remove true hesitation and accidental restarts. Apply explicit corrections to the final stated intent. Preserve meaningful filler-like words and unfinished thoughts. Apply clearly spoken punctuation and list cues. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "we started the screen reader audit at the north desk after the monthly checkout report came in and mara asked me to verify the amount shown beside the audio description equipment. the actual cost was $161.98 not $46.71 and that was the charge on the receipt from harbor sound. the smaller number belonged to a replacement cable in last week's supply log, not to this purchase. i opened the order page with the screen reader running and listened to each field without using the mouse. the vendor name was announced before the item name, but the amount field was read twice when i moved back from the tax line. i checked it again with the receipt and the total still matched at $161.98. the review note should say that the repeated announcement made the amount harder to confirm, not that the total was wrong. i also asked devon to test the page with the keyboard only because the focus indicator disappeared briefly near the download link. we did not change the order or submit a new payment. i saved the audit notes in the shared folder and left the vendor's receipt attached so the next reviewer can compare the labels with the spoken output. mara said she would check the duplicate announcement after the afternoon shift and report whether it happens on another workstation.", "output": "We started the screen reader audit at the north desk after the monthly checkout report came in, and Mara asked me to verify the amount shown beside the audio description equipment. The actual cost was $161.98 not $46.71, and that was the charge on the receipt from Harbor Sound. The smaller number belonged to a replacement cable in last week's supply log, not to this purchase. I opened the order page with the screen reader running and listened to each field without using the mouse. The vendor name was announced before the item name, but the amount field was read twice when I moved back from the tax line. I checked it again with the receipt, and the total still matched at $161.98. The review note should say that the repeated announcement made the amount harder to confirm, not that the total was wrong. I also asked Devon to test the page with the keyboard only because the focus indicator disappeared briefly near the download link. We did not change the order or submit a new payment. I saved the audit notes in the shared folder and left the vendor's receipt attached so the next reviewer can compare the labels with the spoken output. Mara said she would check the duplicate announcement after the afternoon shift and report whether it happens on another workstation."}]
